text: pāṇā paṭhaviṃ sitāti . [165] puttā vatthu manussānaṃ bhariyā paramā sakhā vuṭṭhiṃ bhūtā upajīvanti ye pāṇā paṭhaviṃ sitāti . pañcamaṃ paṭhamajanasuttaṃ [166] kiṃsu janeti purisaṃ kiṃsu tassa vidhāvati kiṃsu saṃsāramāpādi kiṃsu tassa mahabbhayanti . [167] taṇhā janeti purisaṃ cittamassa vidhāvati satto saṃsāramāpādi dukkhamassa mahabbhayanti . chaṭṭhaṃ dutiyajanasuttaṃ [168] kiṃsu
